decisions.summary: The clip per tile, the grid kept at 3 x 3 with TILE_MPX unchanged (D2, Amendment 1), and the note at TILE_MPX corrected (D5).
decisions.why: Round 1's item is resolved. The Summary now says what Amendment 1 says ('clipping only, at 3x3 ... no grid change') and what FR-002 requires. Nothing in the plan still tells the implementer to lower TILE_MPX.

decisions.summary: tile_doc(text, box) does one pass over the lines. Each line starting '<g class="f ' goes through drop_offmap against the tile's box, and every other line is untouched.
decisions.why: This is FR-001 as written: the page's own rule with its margin, applied to classed strings only. Spec round 1 ruled the classed-only scope LEGITIMATE. Removing 'constant-time' corrects a description and changes no scope.

decisions.summary: The grid stays 3 x 3 and TILE_MPX is unchanged. SC-002 is the clipped-against-unclipped A/B of R2.
decisions.why: This is FR-002 and SC-002 after Amendment 1, the GM's 'yes please' to clipping only at 3x3.

decisions.summary: A one-shot run over every live pool map compares clipped tiles against unclipped tiles byte for byte and is recorded in research.md.
decisions.why: This is FR-003 and SC-003 as amended. Unclipped tiles are today's picture.

decisions.summary: The note at TILE_MPX will state R3: 4,319 pixels differ from the single render at 3 x 3, most (about 80%) within two levels and none above 39. A grid change is therefore never byte-identical, and the clip changes no pixel.
decisions.why: Round 1's item is resolved. The wording now matches research.md R3: 2,344 + 1,108 = 3,452 of 4,319 is 79.9%, and none is above 39. This is FR-005 and the GM-approved 'correct that comment to state the measured truth', and the corrected note no longer overstates R3.

decisions.summary: tile_doc inherits the module's Research claims, with impl-drift only where make claims-owed asks.
decisions.why: This is project process and adds nothing to the request.

decisions.summary: tile_doc drops an outside classed line, keeps an inside one and never touches an unclassed line. On a synthetic page with classed ink in one corner, the tiled picture equals its single render.
decisions.why: These tests enforce FR-001 and the test half of SC-001, which names a synthetic page.

decisions.summary: Both perf bookends are taken back to back at the end: the start in a detached worktree at b8b20e690, then perf-gate in the clone.
decisions.why: This is Constitution VI process plus SC-004 and adds nothing to the request.
